name: Early KV preparation
question: Does preparing host-resident KV during tool waits improve replay delay and workload completion without queue ranking or retention changes?
limits: Long synthetic tool waits deliberately create preparation opportunities. Host-to-GPU preparation only; storage disabled. The controller may skip already-resident or insufficiently useful loads.
